newsitem.title: UK: IPE prompt natgas heavily traded, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: IPE prompt natgas heavily traded, prices mixed.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures bounced back on Tuesday afternoon after a slow start to the day, with 835 lots done by the close of trade -- the second highest volume traded since the contract began.

Prompt gas attracted the greatest interest, with 300 lots done in the new balance of the month contract, all at 8.90 pence a therm. This compares with a previous settlement price of 9.01 pence on Monday, the first day on which the contract traded.
A further 305 lots were traded in September at between 8.92 pence and 8.97 pence, down from a settlement level of 9.00 pence on Monday.

Further out volumes were thinner, but each of the 13 listed contracts except June and August were traded. Price changes were minor and mixed. With the exception of the balance of the month contract, which fell by 0.11 penny, there was no price movement greater than 0.06 penny a therm. Four of the traded contracts were up, five were down and two were unchanged.
